title.zh: Python's experimental JIT to be removed
title.en: Python's experimental JIT to be removed

current_state.zh: CPython's experimental JIT is being removed after its supporting PEP was not accepted and the developers said they lacked the personal bandwidth to carry the current implementation forward, shelving a project that had been expected to offset free-threading performance costs.
current_state.en: CPython's experimental JIT is being removed after its supporting PEP was not accepted and the developers said they lacked the personal bandwidth to carry the current implementation forward, shelving a project that had been expected to offset free-threading performance costs.
